_note: Major road projects from web research (verified July 2026). Shown on the dashboard as corridor watchlist. Overpass supplies live geometry; this file supplies context/status for corridors that may not be mapped in OSM yet.

projects.name: Bar–Boljare motorway (A-1), Section 2: Mateševo–Andrijevica
projects.route: Mateševo (end of existing Smokovac–Mateševo section) → Andrijevica, toward Berane; TEN-T Route 4 / Belgrade–Bar corridor
projects.notes: €694m design-build signed 27.02.2026 (PowerChina–STECOL–PCCD); EBRD €200m + EU grant €150m. Preparatory works June 2026; 14 mo design + 46 mo construction (~2031). Expropriation corridor = active land-value signal (Kolašin/Andrijevica/Berane).

projects.name: Budva bypass (Markovići–Lastva Grbaljska expressway)
projects.route: Markovići (east of Budva) around Budva → Lastva Grbaljska (toward Tivat/Kotor); first segment of Adriatic-Ionian coastal expressway
projects.notes: Contractor selected June 2026, €196m + ~€20m expropriation; 48-month deadline (~end-2029). Preparatory works autumn 2026.

projects.name: Tivat–Jaz boulevard (Jadranska magistrala upgrade)
projects.route: Jaz beach (west of Budva) → Tivat airport zone
projects.notes: Four lanes, 12 roundabouts; €53.9m; opening for summer 2026 season. Follow-on Tivat town boulevard in design tender.

projects.name: Podgorica bypass: Smokovac–Tološi–Farmaci
projects.route: Smokovac interchange (existing motorway) via Tološi to Farmaci — western bypass of Podgorica toward Bar
projects.notes: Conceptual design call 29.04.2026 (Monteput); TEN-T early market engagement June 2026. Not yet tendered — earliest-stage signal, northern Podgorica land impact.

projects.name: Bar–Boljare Section 3: Andrijevica–Berane–Boljare
projects.route: Andrijevica via Berane to Boljare (Serbian border)
projects.notes: Conceptual design phase only; connects to planned Serbian Požega–Boljare corridor.

projects.name: Adriatic–Ionian expressway/motorway
projects.route: Croatian border → Tivat → Budva (Paštrovačka gora) → Bar → Ulcinj → Albanian border
projects.notes: Early planning; junction study with Bar–Boljare at Paštrovačka gora tendered 2026. Long-horizon signal.

projects.name: Morava Corridor motorway (A5, E-761)
projects.route: Pojate (A1) – Kruševac – Trstenik – Vrnjačka Banja – Kraljevo – Preljina/Čačak (A2)
projects.notes: Bechtel-Enka. Most sections open; final Kruševac/Adrani sections targeted mid-late 2026.

projects.name: Fruška Gora Corridor (Novi Sad–Ruma)
projects.route: Novi Sad (Petrovaradin) – Iriški Venac – Irig – Ruma (A3)
projects.notes: Iriški Venac tunnel ~3.5 km + new Danube bridge in Novi Sad. CRBC. Completion late 2026–2027.

projects.name: Belgrade–Zrenjanin–Novi Sad motorway
projects.route: Belgrade (Borča) – Pančevo north – Kovačica – Zrenjanin – Novi Sad
projects.notes: Shandong Hi-Speed, ~€1.3bn. First section Belgrade–Kovačica (~30 km) targeted end-2026; full ~2030.

projects.name: Kuzmin–Sremska Rača motorway + Sava bridge (Belgrade–Sarajevo highway)
projects.route: Kuzmin (A3) – Sremska Rača – BiH border (toward Bijeljina)
projects.notes: Final phase; opening announced ~October 2026. Continuation Rača–Bijeljina co-financed in RS entity of BiH.

projects.name: Niš–Merdare 'Peace Highway' Phase 1 (Niš–Pločnik)
projects.route: Niš (Merošina) – Prokuplje – Beloljin/Pločnik, toward Kuršumlija and Merdare
projects.notes: EU/EIB/EBRD-backed; significant delays. Full route to Merdare ~77 km; Pločnik–Merdare in design.

projects.name: Vožd Karađorđe expressway (phase 1)
projects.route: Mali Požarevac (A1) – Sopot – Mladenovac – Aranđelovac – Topola – Rača – Lapovo/Velika Plana – Svilajnac – Despotovac
projects.notes: Shandong contract May 2026 (~€1.3bn); machines deploying spring 2026. Full corridor ~242 km toward Bor.

projects.name: Belgrade bypass Sector C (A9)
projects.route: Bubanj Potok – Boleč – Vinča – Danube bridge – Pančevo
projects.notes: Spatial-plan drafting since Nov 2025. High land-value impact Grocka/Pančevo — earliest-stage signal.

projects.name: Osmeh Vojvodine expressway
projects.route: Bački Breg (HU border) – Sombor – Kula – Vrbas – Srbobran – Bečej – Novi Bečej – Kikinda – Nakovo (RO border)
projects.notes: Early/preparatory works at multiple points (May 2026 permit). First section Bački Breg–Kljajićevo ~2028.

projects.name: Požega–Boljare motorway (A2 continuation toward Montenegro)
projects.route: Požega – Arilje – Ivanjica – Duga Poljana – Boljare (ME border); branch Požega–Užice–Kotroman (BiH) also planned
projects.notes: Joint Serbia–Montenegro announcement 2026; design/preparation stage.

projects.name: A2 Kičevo–Ohrid motorway (Corridor 8)
projects.notes: Sinohydro; 37 of 57 km done April 2026, government says OPENS END OF 2026. Highest-priority MK corridor for land-value change: Kičevo, Izvor, Preseka, Ohrid interchanges.

projects.name: Corridor 8: Tetovo–Gostivar (section 1)
projects.notes: Part of €1.3bn Bechtel-Enka package (to 2027-2029).

projects.name: Corridor 8: Gostivar–Bukojčani (section 2)
projects.route: Gostivar – Bukojčani, mountainous new alignment toward Kičevo
projects.notes: Bechtel-Enka; works on 11 of 31 km (Feb 2026), in use by END 2029. Onward Bukojčani-Kičevo 10-13 km separately financed (EBRD €110m + EU €20m) — together the 42 km Gostivar-Kičevo motorway.

projects.name: Corridor 8: Trebeništa–Struga–Ćafasan
projects.notes: Bechtel-Enka, started 2024. Struga-Ćafasan alignment near Lake Ohrid faces UNESCO objections — final alignment may shift; watch JPDP monthly supervision reports before buying there.

projects.name: Corridor 10d: Prilep–Bitola motorway
projects.notes: Bechtel-Enka; ~half-built mid-2026, first carriageway segment traffic imminent, full completion END 2027. Flat agricultural land along Pelagonija — prime target.

projects.name: A4 Skopje–Blace motorway (link to Kosovo)
projects.notes: EBRD-financed, early works, ~4-year horizon.

projects.name: A4 Štip–Radoviš expressway
projects.notes: Listed 'Ongoing' on roads.org.mk/proekti; eastern MK expressway program.

projects.name: Corridor Vc (A1) - Medakovo-Ozimice
projects.notes: Contractor Cengiz Insaat (TR), EUR 362m, signed Mar 2023; part of EU-backed Corridor Vc.

projects.name: Corridor Vc (A1) - Zenica gorge sections
projects.notes: Four contiguous sections incl. 3.6 km Bosna tunnel, various contractors (Cengiz, HGG, Azvirt/Hering, Euro-Asfalt).

projects.name: Corridor Vc (A1) - Tunnel Kvanj-Buna
projects.notes: China Road and Bridge Corporation consortium, contract signed Oct 2024.

projects.name: Corridor Vc in Republika Srpska - Vukosavlje-Brcko
projects.notes: RS entity motorway, Chinese contractors; part of northern Corridor Vc / Brcko link.

projects.name: A7 extension - Krizisce-Jadranovo
projects.notes: First subsection of A7 southward extension along the coast; contract signed, works underway; opens access to Crikvenica hinterland.

projects.name: A1 Zagreb-Karlovac third-lane widening
projects.notes: Widening of Croatia's busiest section to 2x3 lanes; tender late 2025, completion targeted 2028 (contract for first works signed per HAC news).

projects.name: Split junction reconstruction and D403-type access upgrades
projects.notes: Reconstruction and expansion of the Split interchange on A1.

projects.name: Third Development Axis - North (Velenje-Slovenj Gradec)
projects.notes: Expressway 4-lane; multiple lots under construction (e.g. Skalsko jezero and Konovo lots, EUR 55m contract).

projects.name: Third Development Axis - North (Sentrupert-Velenje)
projects.notes: Connects A1 motorway to Velenje; lots progressively contracted.

projects.name: Third Development Axis - South
projects.notes: First stage (Novo mesto east bypass with Revoz access) under construction; later stages to Bela krajina planned.

projects.name: Karavanke Tunnel second tube (A2)
projects.notes: Second tube completed Mar 2026; refurbishment of the 1991 tube ongoing - limited new land impact.

projects.name: R7.1 Prishtina-Gjilan-Koncul highway
projects.route: Prishtine - Gjilan - Dheu i Bardhe/Koncul (Serbia border)
projects.notes: Kosovo's third highway, built in 7 segments; Prishtina-Gjilan expressway sections progressively under works/opening.

projects.name: Prishtina-Merdare motorway completion (R6.1/Nis link)
projects.notes: Kosovo side of the Peace Highway toward Nis; design/EIB-EBRD supported, sections in preparation.

projects.name: Prishtina-Blace / Skopje link upgrade
projects.notes: Contract activity on Skopje-Blace corridor referenced in MIT news; connects to NMK A4 to Skopje.

projects.name: Thumana-Kashar motorway (PPP)
projects.notes: Key A1-Tirana link on the north-south corridor; concession/PPP works ongoing.

projects.name: Milot-Balldren motorway (PPP)
projects.notes: Adriatic corridor segment toward Shkodra/Montenegro (Blue Corridor).

projects.name: Kardhiq-Delvine road
projects.notes: Long-running mountain road nearing completion; cuts Saranda access time, strong riviera land impact.

projects.name: Adriatic-Ionian corridor (Blue Highway) remaining sections
projects.notes: Northern continuation toward Montenegro; feasibility/design with IFI support.

projects.name: E65 Central Greece Motorway - northern section
projects.notes: Final E65 stretch linking Thessaly to Egnatia; opening in stages 2025-2026, strong land impact in W. Macedonia/Thessaly.

projects.name: BOAK - Northern Crete Motorway
projects.notes: Crete's first true motorway; Hersonissos-Neapoli works underway, main Chania-Heraklion concession ramping up - biggest new-corridor play in Greece.

projects.name: Thessaloniki Flyover (eastern ring road upgrade)
projects.notes: Elevated expressway over existing ring; completion around 2027.

projects.name: Patras-Pyrgos motorway (Olympia Odos extension)
projects.notes: Final sections opening 2025-2026; unlocks western Peloponnese coast.

projects.name: Thessaloniki-Edessa and Drama-Amfipoli vertical axes
projects.notes: Two large northern Greece road projects at contractor-selection stage per ypodomes.com (mid-2026).

projects.name: S1 Wiener Aussenring Schnellstraase Schwechat-Suessenbrunn (incl. Lobautunnel)
projects.notes: Open-land 10.8 km phase started spring 2026 (~EUR 500m); Lobau tunnel phase ~2030 start, EUR 2.2bn, completion to 2032/2040.

projects.name: A26 Linzer Autobahn, Bauabschnitt 2
projects.notes: Danube bridge section opened 2024; tunnel sections into Linz under construction into the 2030s.

projects.name: S10 Muehlviertler Schnellstrasse north extension
projects.route: Freistadt Nord - Rainbach Nord (toward CZ border/D3 link)
projects.notes: Continues in ASFINAG 2026-2031 programme; links to Czech D3 at Wullowitz/Dolni Dvoriste.

projects.name: A5 Nord/Weinviertel Autobahn completion
projects.notes: Re-added to ASFINAG construction programme 2026; connects to Czech D52 toward Brno.

projects.name: A20 Kuestenautobahn
projects.notes: Germany's largest greenfield motorway project; symbolic groundbreaking in Lower Saxony, first sections in works, incl. planned Elbe tunnel at Drochtersen.

projects.name: A14 Nordverlaengerung
projects.notes: Multiple sections under construction in Saxony-Anhalt, Brandenburg and Mecklenburg; closes the last big north-south gap in eastern Germany.

projects.name: A100 16./17. Bauabschnitt Berlin
projects.route: Neukoelln - Treptower Park (- Storkower Strasse planned)
projects.notes: Urban motorway extension; 16th section nearing completion, 17th section politically contested.

projects.name: A8 Albaufstieg
projects.notes: Planning approval Dec 2024; construction preparation underway; new tunnels and viaducts, Baden-Wuerttemberg's largest road project.

projects.name: Second Gotthard road tunnel (A2)
projects.notes: Flagship Swiss project; second tube under construction, opening ~2029-2030, then refurbishment of the old tube.

projects.name: A9 completion in Upper Valais
projects.notes: Last unfinished stretch of the original national road network; several sections and tunnels in works.

projects.name: A1 six-lane expansion Aarau Ost - Birrfeld
projects.notes: Part of Ausbauschritt 2027 / Verkehr '45; note the Nov 2024 referendum rejected the previous STEP 2023 package (Rhine tunnel Basel, 3rd Rosenberg tube etc.).

projects.name: A1 six-lane expansion Perly - Bernex
projects.notes: Proposed in Ausbauschritt 2027; subject to parliamentary approval and possible referendum.

projects.name: D35 Hradec Kralove - Olomouc corridor
projects.route: Hradec Kralove - Vysoke Myto - Mohelnice (parallel relief for D1)
projects.notes: Multiple sections under construction; separate D35 Ulibice-Horice 16.3 km section started April 2026.

projects.name: D11 Jaromer - Trutnov (- PL border)
projects.route: Jaromer - Trutnov - Krkonose/Poland (links to Polish S3)
projects.notes: Last missing D11 section; completion expected autumn 2029.

projects.name: D6 Prague - Karlovy Vary
projects.route: Krusovice - Bosov area sections toward Karlovy Vary
projects.notes: Several sections in works; full Prague-Karlovy Vary motorway targeted ~2029.

projects.name: D3 Central Bohemia (PPP)
projects.route: Prague (D0) - Nova Hospoda, connecting to completed South Bohemian D3 to Austria
projects.notes: Procured as PPP; South Bohemian D3 to Dolni Dvoriste/AT border largely complete or finishing.

projects.name: D1 Lietavska Lucka - Dubna Skala (Visnove tunnel)
projects.route: Lietavska Lucka - Dubna Skala (Zilina bypass, Bratislava-Kosice corridor)
projects.notes: Includes 7.5 km Visnove tunnel, Slovakia's longest; long-delayed, in finishing phase; listed on NDS construction page.

projects.name: D3 Zilina Brodno - Kysucke Nove Mesto
projects.route: Zilina/Brodno - Kysucke Nove Mesto (Kysuce corridor toward PL border)
projects.notes: Key section of D3 toward Poland; listed as active construction by NDS.

projects.name: R4 Presov northern bypass, phase I-II
projects.notes: Phase I with Bikos tunnel opened; phase II in construction/procurement; Via Carpatia corridor.

projects.name: D1 Turany - Hubova
projects.route: Turany - Hubova (last missing D1 link under Mala Fatra)
projects.notes: Final gap on Bratislava-Kosice D1; tunnel-heavy alignment, procurement/preparation as of 2026.

projects.name: D1 Bratislava - Triblavina widening
projects.notes: Capacity expansion east of Bratislava; listed on NDS construction page.

projects.name: M49 expressway
projects.route: M3 (Ororszlany/Mateszalka area) - Okoritofulpos, ultimately toward Csenger/RO border
projects.notes: New expressway toward Romania (Satu Mare); listed on beruhazas.gov.hu.

projects.name: M1 widening Budapest - Gyor
projects.notes: Concession-financed capacity upgrade of Hungary's busiest motorway; phased works through late 2020s.

projects.name: M100 expressway
projects.notes: New 2x2 link connecting Esztergom industrial zone (Suzuki) to M1; works started, schedule slipped with budget freezes.

projects.name: M44 final stage
projects.notes: Closing stage links completed M44 (Bekescsaba corridor) directly to M5.

projects.name: M2 upgrade Vac area
projects.route: Vac-del - Vac-eszak (- Retsag bypass toward Hont/SK border)
projects.notes: 2x2 upgrade continuing M2 north toward Slovakia; design phase, Retsag bypass project listed on beruhazas.gov.hu.
